entry.title: DOOM Eternal v0.7.3
entry.content:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.7.3
Bug fixes for Linux/Proton disconnections, item and DeathLink delivery, stuck encounters, and the broken camera after dying without a usable weapon.
Use **Mod and APWorld 0.7.3** with **Sentinel Core 1.1.4**.
## Launcher and connection
- Fixed Linux/Proton disconnections ("keepalive ping timeout") while the game was running. Checking whether DOOM is running no longer blocks the connection to the Archipelago server. - Fixed automatic reconnection failing with an error after the client switched from `ws://` to `wss://`. - When the game connection helper stops under Linux/Proton, the launcher now says so and suggests checking the selected Proton version, instead of asking to close a game that is not running.
## Item delivery and DeathLink
- Fixed items and DeathLinks not arriving in game on some machines until a relaunch. The Core rejected valid game reads that took slightly longer than its time limit; that limit is now more tolerant. - DeathLinks that the Core refuses before running them are now retried instead of being lost.
## Encounters and enemy randomization
- `ap_finish_encounter` can now also end an encounter stuck waiting for enemies that never spawned, where it previously answered "No active encounter". - Tentacles are no longer in the default enemy pool for new rooms; they can still be enabled through Bestiary Weights. In existing rooms, Tentacles are replaced by a mobile enemy when the launcher prepares the room package again, since a Tentacle in an unreachable spot could keep an encounter from ending (for example, the **Super Gore Nest** Slayer Gate and the arena after the BFG in **Mars Core**). - Fixed floating hands, a broken camera and the player appearing tiny after dying or loading a checkpoint with no ammo and a randomized Chainsaw. The player's owned weapon is now selected even when it has no ammo.
## Campaign menu
- The Slayer Gate icon in the mission menu now shows a Gate as completed only when you completed it in game in this save. A Gate collected by another player stays open, so you still know to complete it for its Empyrean Key. Gates completed before this version show as open until completed again.
## Support Reports and diagnostics
- Added diagnostics for Ammo Refill, showing what each ammo pool had before and after a refill. - Added diagnostics for encounters whose enemies fail to spawn and for `ap_finish_encounter` refusals. - Added diagnostics for goal evaluation, recording why victory was or was not sent. - Spawn position diagnostics now cover every map instead of only the first one.
**These fixes do not require a new room. Rooms that work with v0.7.2 keep working. The Tentacle default applies to rooms generated with APWorld v0.7.3; the Tentacle replacement in existing rooms applies when the launcher prepares the room package again.**

entry.title: Dead Cells v0.2.0
entry.content:
New Features: - Added an option for enemy sanity checks, meaning killing one enemy of each kind counts as a check - Added a room randomizer (will randomly switch biome places) with 3 options: - depth: close to the classic experience by only swapping biomes in the same depth - tier: swaps the biomes by groups delimited by bosses - chaotic: can replace any biome with any other biome - Note that the Bank still works in the same way as usual - This gamemode is still a work in progress, so it is not advised to use it in multiplayer, the in-game tracker isn’t adapted yet, and some other features may not work correctly. - Gave back a use to the hunter's mirror. - A random accessible enemy will be selected upon interaction with the mirror - Killing the enemy will randomly hint at one of your accessible checks and slightly reduce the price of the mod shop
Gameplay Changes: - Now shop mimic blueprints also have a hunter's grenade requirement - The distillery doesn’t require you to have seen the throne room beforehand - Increased the number of lore rooms in Prisoners’ Quarters to a maximum of 4 new and 2 previously generated and not looted - Disclaimer: adding more rooms increases the complexity of the level and increases the time needed for generation, so it is advised to loot them as soon as possible - Changed fixed weapon drops, now giving a random filler-like item instead - A trap weight can be selected for the filler generation, and is also used in death traps
Quality of Life: - Refactored the UI control logic to improve stability and allow the use of mouse and controller at the same time without crashing - Writing in a text field locks the cursor in it, avoiding unwanted movements in the menu - Disabled launching the game when connected to an incompatible apworld - Improved responsiveness for text fields and item descriptions
Bug Fixes: - Some item descriptions not being displayed - Mutation checks not being counted for the green hole head - Lag when putting a lot of cells in the forge at once - Warp being based on biome checks - Some crashes caused by a disconnection - Cells being deposited in energy link upon death - Removed the warp option when doing daily challenge, boss rush and training - Hunter grenade icon still showing on mobs without blueprints when picking up the grenade before a blueprint - Bank losing its depth mobs upon reload - Gray text display on biome, showing checks as accessible when they are from non-accessible higher BSC - Scrolls on mobs given again on reload - Flower keys that could be picked multiple times using reload
APWorld Changes: - Complete rework of the apworld, fixing many fill issues - Added the enemy sanity, room randomizer and trap weight options - White hole head now requires one Progressive Flask, Cursed Flask, Tainted Flask, or access to the Bank - Golden Blowtorch is now a Bank item - Spoiler and universal tracker not taking into account that all stem cells are required for the goal
Other: - Changed the image reading library, as SixLabors now requires a license
Compatible with APWorld 0.1.7 and newer

entry.title: Starship Titanic v1.0.0
entry.content:
Major updates to both client and .apworld. Incompatible with older seeds. Make sure to regenerate your YAML templates to see the new options. ## New Features - Full client UI redesign - In-client Logic tracking: See in-logic checks. Hover over locked checks to see what they require - In-client hints: Click just about anything in the client to request a hint for it - New Goal: Parrot Hunt! Receive clues from the multiworld to discover which stateroom the parrot is trapped in - New YAML options (see YAML for detailed descriptions): - Passenger Class Upgrades: Multiworld (default) or Vanilla - Stateroom Assignments: Multiworld (default) or Vanilla - AP Item Delivery Method: Succ-u-Bus (default) or Direct to Inventory - More Room Access Card generation options: Enabled, Randomized, Selection, Disabled (default) - Easy Music Room Puzzle: (default false) When true, pre-sets the music room panel controls to the solution - Skip Intro: Skips past the intro and opening credits - Quick Elevator/Quick Pellerator: Drastically shortens ride animations - Quick Barbot Freakout: Drastically shortens animation and control lockout after completing the Titanic Titillator - New Checks: Puree the Starlings, Defeat the Maitre'D, Music Room puzzle, SGT Stateroom Furniture puzzle, Arboretum Seasons - Added YAML-less UT Support ## Changes - Traps have been removed temporarily. I've never gotten around to implementing them, so they've never actually done anything - Added full [Location](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP/blob/main/docs/Location.md) and [Item](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP/blob/main/docs/Items.md) lists to the repo for reference ## Fixes - Tons of cosmetic fixes affecting most items - Pistachio bowl puzzle required an assigned 2nd class stateroom in logic, but can be completed in any 2nd class stateroom - Checks could briefly be sent from incorrect save files before the guard stops them - Nose could be stuck in inventory in rare circumstances - Mouth could be permanently hidden in very rare circumstances - Being granted an item while standing at its natural pickup location causes issues - Turning in the Magazine before the check-in conversation would eat it with no results - Swapping the music in the restaurant would make fighting the Maitre'D impossible - Repairing Titania would block access to the rest of the ship, blocking progress in goals that don't end there - Installed fuses and Titania parts would be removed and returned to inventory when their checks are sent - Incorrect random room calculation sometimes assigned a Parrot Hunt room that didn't exist - Fixed a few minor logic issues - Fixed several crash causes ## Known Issues in this release - None
Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)

entry.title: Homura-Hime v0.4.0
entry.content:
Feature release: The Climax is its own world, level key settings, a balanced randomized level order with odds, added two traps, and a number of fixes for the cut-content guns. See README for installation instructions.
**Seeds from 0.3.x are not accepted by this plugin. Update the plugin and the .apworld together and generate a new seed.** An old YAML still works: `level_unlock_items: true` now means freeform keys, and the old `level_order` values `vanilla` and `randomized` still work.
### New:
**Climax: The Choice is a world of its own:**
- The game now has nine worlds before the Finale: Chapters 1-8 and the Climax. The Climax is shuffled like a chapter, is never the first world, needs one cleared chapter before it opens, has its own key ("Climax Unlock") and is required for the Finale.
**Level keys (`level_unlock_items`: off / linear_progression / freeform_progression):**
- Linear progression adds a "Progressive Level Key" item: the first one opens the second world, and so on. Freeform adds one key per world, usable at once in any order. - In freeform mode, using the Torii gate in any hub opens the Chapter Select. - After clearing a world, the hub shows the post-mission report of the world you just cleared (not the story's). - In Linear Progression, the keys are needed to advance but levels must still be played in order (randomized or vanilla). In freeform, levels are accessible and in-logic as soon as a key is obtained.
**Randomized Order (`level_order`: off / balanced / full):**
- Balanced makes Chapters 1-4 likely to come early (the first world is always one of them) and Chapters 5-8 and the Climax likely to come late. Full is a plain shuffle. The later chapters are pretty hard as the first world, so the weighted randomization may make the beginning of the game easier. - With freeform keys, the keys turn up in play order.
**Traps (`puffer_swarm_traps`, default 20, and `hexed_doll_trio_traps`, default 5; both can be `disabled`):**
- **Puffer Swarm Trap**: four flying bomb puffers and four flying spiky puffers appear around you, 6 to 20 metres away. - **Hexed Doll Trio Trap**: a Hexed Doll of each of the three colours appears as a group, 4 to 8 metres away, with health and stagger bars. - A trap only goes off in a level (never in the hub), while you are in control, and while you stand on solid ground. In the air, on a rail or in a boost it waits until you land. The count is lowered when there is no room in the seed. - The game additively loads a couple scenes at launch during the splash screen to capture the instances of the enemies it needs to spawn. This should have no discernable impact on the game. If you load a save that doesn't use the traps, they'll be removed from memory and the scenes will be re-loaded when connecting to a server that has traps enabled. This may cause a hitch, but will only be at the main menu and only in that niche case.
**Saves:**
- A save that belongs to an Archipelago slot can only be loaded from the main menu while you are connected to that slot and seed. In the Continue panel the other saves are greyed out, with a note at the bottom, and every bound save says which slot it is associated with. Connecting while the panel is open frees the matching saves. Offline play of a bound save is no longer possible. - While the trap setup runs, no save can be loaded and no game started.
### Fixes:
**Cut-content guns:**
- Ruptured Bones (shotgun) and Ann's Board now break the large boxes with Konpeito, like the standard shot. Their damage boxes were solid colliders, which Unity does not report as hits against solid boxes. - Ann's Board shows its name in the menus again (the game's own text calls it "Ann's Support", and the plugin's name was lost when the text was reloaded). - Sounds: the shotgun and Ann's Board play the game's own sounds (the board's when you release the shot, not when it is summoned), and every flame orb of the missile gun plays a short charge sound. - Fortunate Misfortune (missile): the red target boxes and the charged orbs no longer stay on screen after switching guns or cancelling a charge; aiming while a shot is impossible (a boost ring, a cutscene) no longer leaves the gun stuck; the missiles' flame and trail no longer hang in the air after a hit; missiles follow you in a domain; a missile that reaches a spiky puffer or another enemy whose lock point lies outside its hurtbox now hits it instead of circling until it expires. - The standard gun could stop firing after a shot; fixed.
**Generation:**
- Putting every currency and utility item on `local_items` no longer fails for about one seed in eight.
**Connection:**
- Connecting to another slot at the title screen is no longer judged against the save that was played before.
### Known issues:
- Doing the Nurikabe's Hat quest shows the "found the hat" picture although the hat comes from the multiworld. Other quest items probably do the same.

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.3.0a1
entry.content:
CTR Archipelago 0.3.0-alpha1 is up for testing! It's the first build of 0.3.0 and the biggest update so far, so expect rough edges. I'd love your help finding what's broken. **v0.2.4 stays the current stable release.**
[Full 0.3.0 notes on AP-Pie](https://ap-pie.com/ctr/releases/0-3-0) · [Setup guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr) · [SETUP.md as shipped](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/v0.3.0-alpha1/SETUP.md)
## Before you try it
- **Use a new folder.** Your 0.2.4 install and rooms stay as they are, and 0.2.x rooms still need the 0.2.4 client. - **Make a new YAML.** A lot of options and defaults changed. - **This alpha won't update itself.** Grab new alphas by hand.
## What's new
- **A new generator:** seeds are built a new way, and the YAML is one flat list of options. A YAML that sets nothing gives you the original game's shape: 18 tracks, 5 Gem Cups, 4 Crystal Challenges and the boss races, shuffled onto the pads. - **Play Solo:** make and play a one-player seed right from the title screen, no server needed. - **Custom tracks:** import them from a patch against your own disc or download them from Project Saphi, race them in Custom Arcade and Time Trial, and put them in a seed on pads, in cups and as boss tracks. Every track you install shows up in Play Solo, and tracks with weapon crates get AP item boxes. Cortex Vortex is a full track with its own music. - **Wumpa Shop:** every hub has a shop where you spend the fruit you collect on checks. Fruit counts past 10 and goes to your wallet when you finish, and you can replay won tracks to farm more. - **New checks:** Crystalsanity, three new arenas, cup sweeps, lap checks and more. - **Bosses:** random boss tracks, racers and weapons, boss cups and a chaos Final Challenge. - **More:** optional pad approach hints, item and location groups, a Reserve Top-Up filler, new traps, button remapping and an item feed toggle.
## What to test
1. A full seed from a default YAML, start to goal. Tell me if it gets stuck. 2. Your old YAML and a fresh one from the release's `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml`, then try changing pad placement and random requirements. 3. A multiworld with other games, with hints, DeathLink and traps. 4. The Wumpa Shop: collect past 10, finish the race, buy something, and replay a track you've won for more fruit. 5. Custom tracks in a seed and in Play Solo, including their item boxes. 6. Play Solo from each preset and from your own YAML. If it freezes, tell me which track. 7. Bosses, boss cups, the Final Challenge and the new checks.
## Known issues
- Some menus are hard to read, especially Options and Custom Content where text runs over the logo. - The Import Track Files list shows "..." instead of track names, and names come from the patch file name. - A seed can still fail to generate with some unusual YAMLs. Generate again, and send me the YAML. - Short freezes can happen in some races. If you get one, tell me the track.
## Found a problem?
[Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/new/choose) and say it's on 0.3.0-alpha1. Add your platform, YAML or seed, what happened, and the support bundle (`support-bundle.bat` on Windows, `support-bundle.sh` on Linux; look through it before you attach it). Questions are welcome in the [Crash Team Racing channel](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1222304293751750777) on the Archipelago Discord.
## Downloads
On Windows, grab `ctr-archipelago-v0.3.0-alpha1-windows-x86.zip`. On Linux or Steam Deck, grab `ctr-archipelago-v0.3.0-alpha1-linux-x86.tar.gz` (glibc 2.36 or newer). Each includes the client, the matching `ctr.apworld` and the Play Solo runtime (its own Python, so you don't need Python installed). Use the alpha client and the alpha APWorld together. The separate `ctr.apworld` and `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml` are for hosts. You need your own NTSC-U disc; no game data is included. The client isn't code-signed. Play Solo starts its own Python in the background and its server only listens on your own PC; if your antivirus asks about it, that's what it is.
The client is GPL-3.0; the source for this build is the `v0.3.0-alpha1` tag of this repository. Third-party licenses are in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and `solo-runtime/LICENSES/` in each download.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v2.0.0
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Install [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/) and the client, `stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js` from this release, then play on [the official Stick Ranger page](https://dan-ball.jp/en/javagame/ranger/); the [setup guide](https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/blob/main/stick_ranger/docs/setup_en.md) has the details
## Heads up
- **Stick Ranger is now played on its official page at dan-ball.jp.** The client is a Tampermonkey userscript, attached to this release. The old website client is gone. - **Early goals are in.** You can now finish on Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid or Ice Castle; see below. - **Your 1.8 yaml still generates.** The new options take their defaults, and a yaml asking for 22 Hell stages reads as the new maximum of 21. Regenerate the template to see the new options. - **Seeds from apworld 1.8.12 and 1.8.13 play in the new client.** Seeds from before 1.8.12 are not supported. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## The userscript client
- Install [stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js](https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/releases/latest/download/stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js) with Tampermonkey. In Chrome and Edge, turn on **Allow User Scripts** for Tampermonkey first. Tampermonkey keeps the script up to date from the latest release. - The game loads from dan-ball.jp as always; the script adds an Archipelago window on top of it. Stick Ranger is made by ha55ii, and nothing of the game is part of this project. - Everything the old client did is there: stage, class and shop checks, book and shop hints, traps, DeathLink, Ring Link, the multipliers, the map colours, Forget Tree class swaps, free revival with the whole party down, removable compos, and the AP logo ranger symbol.
## Early goals
- **New goals: Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid and Ice Castle**, next to Mountaintop, Hell Castle, Volcano and the combined goals. - **Everything past your goal is cut**: those stages, their books, enemies and shop rows hold no checks, and their unlocks are never handed out. Boss stages beside your goal that it does not need stay playable but only hold filler. Once you goal, every stage past it opens for free play and every shop is fully stocked. - **Mountaintop is gated like Ice Castle** instead of behind Hell Castle, since it sits in the snow, and the Unlock !!! stage now counts towards Ice instead of Hell. - **New options**: `towns_in_pool` (which towns can be unlocked), `surplus_classes` (what happens to the classes your goal does not need), `cap_loot_at_goal` (filler weapons and compos no stronger than your goal's area) and `scale_loot_with_progress` (filler that grows stronger as your run opens up). - The client's `!hint stage` and `!hint class` follow your goal, so a Mountaintop goal never asks for Ice Castle.
## AP mode and your normal save
- Connecting reloads the page into AP mode (the address ends in `#ap`). In AP mode the game neither reads nor writes your normal Stick Ranger save; **Disconnect** brings it back. - Rankings are off in AP mode, so multiworld runs never reach Dan-Ball's leaderboards.
## Launcher
- **Stick Ranger Client** is back in the Launcher. It opens the game page; from a room page, clicking your slot name opens it with the server, port and slot filled in.
## Fixes
- **New Game** gives back every item received so far at once, without reconnecting. - **Traps** hit a slot only once: starting a New Game or reconnecting never fires them again. - **Full Screen** shows only the game and the Archipelago window.

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.5.0rc1
entry.content:
## v0.5.0-rc1
### New Features - Added eight Area Key progression items for Areas 2 through 9. Cross-area mirrors (and other transitions like Warp Stars) now require the destination area's key (Issue #42). - Add a default-on Area Keys option under Make the game easier. Turning it off removes Area Key requirements and replaces the eight keys with filler. - Added 15 Hub Connection progression items that unlock matching hub shortcuts while preserving alternate overland routes. Physical Big Switch checks remain independent, and received connections are restored across reconnects (Issue #482). - Add Hub Teleport Trap, which returns Kirby to Rainbow Route’s central hub (Issue #697). - Add `/goal` to display the seed's victory condition, including its resolved boss target while preserving legacy hidden targets (Issue #923). - Add Defeat a Number of Area Bosses: defeat any 1–8 distinct area bosses, default 3 (Issue #973). Other goals ignore the count. New count-goal seeds require the updated KirbyAM client; older clients interpret the new goal as Dark Mind.
### Improvements - None.
### Known Limitations - Only the North American ROM is supported; AP notifications are English. - Chests retain their original item sprites and collection animations; statues retain their original ability appearance. Mirrors and warp stars locked by Area Keys have no visual indicator. - mGBA notifications require the visible **Archipelago Connector** scripting panel; they are plain text, not game-image overlays.
### Bug Fixes - Avoid a misleading ROM compatibility warning when disconnecting from the server. - Resume item delivery and gameplay polling when continuing a completed save, while keeping ending, title and demo screens deferred (Issue #1004). - Keep duplicate incoming DeathLinks suppressed when reconnecting to the same seed and slot. - Preserve Mr. Frosty’s ice cubes and Boxy’s boxes as no-ability sources when passive-enemy ability randomization is disabled. - Keep Invincibility Candy queued until its native effect can start, including after leaving hubs or boss rooms and after an active Candy effect expires. - Honor excluded passive enemies, minibosses, and boss spawns in Completely Random ability mode. - Make repeated explicit `/toggle_text` disable commands safe for Kirby slots. - Recreate the mGBA connector listener after socket errors and ignore callbacks from an obsolete listener. - Keep Moonlight arrivals in Olive 6-13 behind the received Olive lever wall while preserving the physical RoomSanity check and return chute. - Retry mGBA connections after self-connected sockets or malformed VERSION replies instead of stopping the client. Shared Archipelago transport and the stock BizHawk launcher are unchanged. - Preserve excluded Minny grants in Completely Random mode while retaining normal ability gating (Issue #997). - Correct the Carrot Castle lever placement and labels to room 5-05 (Issue #972). - Restore outgoing DeathLink detection on dead gameplay frames while keeping fresh item delivery paused. Links received while already dead no longer kill the next respawn (Issue #975). - Restore packaged region discovery on Python 3.11 by using a package resource anchor. - Fix room-sanity generation by making each physical room check reachable from its valid compartment and restoring the missing Moonlight 2-05 lower descent (Issues #945, #969). - Random-per-room colors now update Kirby and the HUD when native palette transformations remain enabled during gameplay (Issue #966). - Allow the six guaranteed starting ability receipts and notices during the tutorial. Other items stay deferred, and Sword still requires its ability item (Issue #967). - Bootstrap Kirby build/test dependencies with checksum-pinned pip 26.2.2 and certifi 2026.10.19 after the eMudhra/emSign incident (Issue #978), with matching development guidance. Global AP dependencies, Docker and general workflows are unchanged.
### Internal Changes - Preserve compiled Hub switch mapping with generated lookup tables, fixed configuration addresses and explicit overlap checks. Historical native door aliases remain unchanged. - Verify the complete wheel inventory and SHA-256 bytes before offline Kirby ROM-smoke dependency installation (Issue #980; broader dependency matrices remain open). - Pin Kirby workflow actions to audited commit identities and reject mutable action references (Issue #981; interpreter/toolchain downloads remain separate). - Add draft-artifact receipts, signed provenance and download verification; refuse published-asset replacement (Issue #983). Plugin-trust guidance and owner immutability prerequisites are documented. - Gate Kirby publication on protected tags, release-environment approval and trusted-main validation; remove publisher PR authority and limit self-hosted smoke runs to main (Issue #982). - Carry the abandoned v0.4.2 security work into v0.5.0; see the [integration plan](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/blob/98ffe79fcef2e24690ec7d3fd7916cb07b1ef684/worlds/kirbyam/dev-docs/v050-security-integration.md) for dependencies and pending acceptance gates. - Execute the full native mailbox/ACK path for all 24 Spray Paint/Music Sheet IDs and Vitality grants for all four player structures, including duplicate delivery and dead-state safety (Issues #971, #953). - Exercise all eight shard receipts through twelve cold client/transport restarts, partial native saves and interleaved acknowledged food receipts (Issue #974). - Verify starting Vitality with stock-server empty/nonempty normal histories, duplicate precollects and repeated cold-RAM recovery without replay healing (Issue #943). - Integrate room connections and requirements into world-generation logic (PR #914).

entry.title: UZDoom v0.9.2
entry.content:
# 0.9.2
This is a bugfix release. There are new yaml options and tools for logic developers, but its main purpose is to fix several important bugs in 0.9.0 and 0.9.1 -- most notably an issue where combat logic often would not work at all.
⚠️ This version remains backwards compatible with 0.9.0 and 0.9.1, but since item categorization has changed, updating your logic packs (and rescanning any that you've made yourself) is recommended.
⚠️ New yaml options! Regen your templates.
🛈 [Logic pack downloads](../../blob/uzap-0.9.2/gzap/doc/support-table.md)
- New: - `ap_no_pool` category allows excluding items from the pool while still randomizing their locations. - Ashes 2063 logic updated to use `ap_no_pool` for the starting revolver. - All logic updated to use `ap_no_pool` for Allmaps. - Allmaps are now `medium` items for the purposes of location selection. - `progression_weapons_only` setting to include only logically required weapons in the pool. - For logic developers: - `spawn@tid` event type for spawn events targeting `MapSpots` and other TID-based spawns. (This doesn't really do anything you couldn't do before, but it makes it more convenient.) - Exiting a level normally (i.e. via an exit, not via the level select screen) will dump all regions in the level to the tuning file automatically. - Changed: - `medium` and `small` items now default to being unrandomized again, rather than shuffled. - `key` items are now always included in pretuning mode, since otherwise you can't pick them up at all. - Fixed: - "Invalid slot" error when using locally-generated PK3s and running the client without the `--slot` flag. - Doom 2 now has complete tuning for all items, thanks to Xindage. - Several problems with weapon logic either not working at all or not working properly. - Scanner crash when `cluster` directive is used. - Pretuning mode and, more generally, `vanilla` key placement no longer interacts badly with keys valid across multiple levels. - Hubclusters that appear in the middle of an episode (i.e. where the first map of the cluster is *not* the first map of the episode) are no longer unreachable from the level select screen. - Hitting a check inside a region, where your set of active keys includes keys not part of the region access requirements, now associates those keys with the check, making it possible to define locations that have more stringent access requirements than the regions that contain them. - `spawn` and `spawn@tid` EBLs targeting weapon types will now properly spawn a check when the weapon first appears, rather than waiting until the weapon locking subsystem thinks you're allowed to pick up the weapon.

entry.title: Homura-Hime v0.4.1
entry.content:
Feature release: the Soul Cores are items that gate the Chapter 6-8 boss fights, a new goal that only needs Chapters 6-8, optional locations as one setting, and options presets. See README for installation instructions.
**Update the plugin and the .apworld together and generate a new seed.** Seeds from 0.4.0 still play with this plugin, but they have no Soul Cores and no new goal. Two options of the YAML changed (see below): a YAML that names `encounter_clears` or `encounter_rewards` has to be edited.
### New:
**Soul Cores are items:**
- Each boss of Levels 1-5 leaves a Soul Core, and Chapters 6-8 fight the same five bosses again. The five Soul Cores (Agasa's, Ling Ling's, Chirakuin's, Yumiko & Kumiko's and Mamiya's) are now items of the multiworld, and the way to each rematch needs the core of that boss. - Without the core, the transition does nothing and the game says "<Name>'s Soul Core required to continue". This covers the doors to Ling Ling and the Corpse Princess, Nozomi, Yumiko & Kumiko's Demonic Realm and the Realm's own door, the walk to the memory tree before Agasa, and the pathway across the end of Chapter 8's last area before Mamiya. Everything else that leads to those fights (the Chapter Select, automatic changes of scene) is refused as well. - The hub used to hand the cores out when a world was cleared. Those five hand-overs are locations now ("Hub: Soul Core (1st World Cleared)" up to the 5th). The hub follows the number of worlds you have cleared, so the n-th core's location is checked after the n-th world you clear, whichever world that is. The cores are always shuffled, whatever `shuffle_key_items` says. - Shops show the Soul Cores with their own picture and description.
**Goal (`goal`: all_worlds / return_all_soul_cores):**
- `return_all_soul_cores` opens the Finale as soon as Chapters 6, 7 and 8 are cleared (which takes every Soul Core). Chapters 1-5 and the Climax stay playable for their checks but are not needed. It shortens the game when Chapters 6-8 can come before the other worlds: with a randomized order, or with freeform level keys. In the story order without freeform keys every world comes before Chapter 8 anyway. - The goal is still reported by the Kill ending, and a save has to have reached the Finale by the new rule.
**Optional locations (`optional_locations`, default on) replace `encounter_rewards`; `encounter_clears` is gone:**
- Every fight is a location now (110), always. Removed the toggle for removing mandatory fights as locations. - `optional_locations` decides whether the optional content counts: the ambush fights and their chests, the glitched-spirit trials, the Kushinada head chases and the optional fights (78 locations in all, the same ones `optional_location_importance` is about). Off: they are not locations, the game hands out what it always did there, and the fixed items they held leave the pool.
**Options presets:** Standard (the defaults), Balanced Random (balanced order, progressive keys, few traps) and Chaos (full random order, freeform keys, the Return All Soul Cores goal, most values random, Death Link on, cut content and advanced movement on).
**Packaging:** the .apworld is built with Archipelago's own "Build APWorlds" tool and keeps the tests out of the package; the world has a bug report page.
### Changes:
- The sample YAML is regenerated for this version.
### Known issues:
- Doing the Nurikabe's Hat quest shows the "found the hat" picture although the hat comes from the multiworld. Other quest items probably do the same. Undecided if I want to keep this behavior or not.

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.5.0rc2
entry.content:
# ⚠️ NOT READY — EXPECT ISSUES
**This is an experimental prerelease, not a stable release. Bugs, regressions and incomplete behavior are expected.** Please report problems you encounter.
## KirbyAM v0.5.0-rc2
This second release candidate includes merged PRs #1013, #1014, #1015, #1018 and #1029.
### v0.5.0 highlights - Eight Area Keys gate cross-area transitions. Locked mirrors show boards and associated Warp Stars stay hidden until eligible. The Area Keys option is enabled by default. - Fifteen Hub Connection progression items unlock hub shortcuts independently of physical Big Switch checks. - New Hub Teleport Trap, `/goal` command, and Defeat a Number of Area Bosses goal (1–8 bosses, default 3). New count-goal seeds require the updated KirbyAM client. - Eight new palettes: Rainbow, Candy Corn, Negative, Pineapple, Cotton Candy, Royal, Pumpkin and Mint Chip, including UFO and HUD support. - Fix repeated healing sounds at 50% enemy health and accurate scaled health meters. - Fixes for DeathLink/reconnect behavior, item delivery after completed saves, ability exclusions, queued Invincibility Candy, room-sanity reachability, Moonlight and Carrot Castle levers, tutorial receipts, random-per-room palettes and mGBA reconnects. - Release preparation/readiness checks, staging status, artifact verification and workflow hardening; isolated graph-cache test fixtures and expanded native/client regression coverage.
See the [full v0.5.0 changelog](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/blob/5bdc27100937db5362949ec8b3e3089c83fd4d13/worlds/kirbyam/CHANGELOG.md) for details.
### Known limitations - Only the North American ROM is supported; AP notifications are English. No ROM is included. - Chests retain their original item sprites and collection animations; statues retain their original ability appearance. - mGBA notifications require the visible **Archipelago Connector** scripting panel; they are plain text, not game-image overlays.
### Source and artifact verification Tag: `kirbyam-v0.5.0-rc2` Source: `5bdc27100937db5362949ec8b3e3089c83fd4d13`
The verified APWorld is attached as `kirbyam.apworld`. The candidate artifact comes from the [successful main-branch APWorld build](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/actions/runs/41985114660) at this exact source commit. Its receipt and SHA-256 were verified, and all 327 packaged files were compared with the checkout, allowing only the expected builder-added manifest fields. No full ROM is included.
`kirbyam.apworld` SHA-256: ```text 0191a9dbe23eb794e7c62e50cd42f8cb8e56945f4adf6c86d448d092f98b3659 ```
**Automatic release staging is incomplete:** the tag-specific metadata check requires a `v0.5.0-rc2` changelog heading, while this source has `v0.5.0`. The candidate receipt identifies the main-branch build; it is not signed tag-based release provenance. No tag-based attestation is supplied. Protected-tag/environment and immutable-release prerequisites have not been verified. This prerelease does not claim full release-readiness or that all CI tests passed.

entry.title: Northgard v2026.11.5
entry.content:
> **Still the Bifrost Alpha.** This one's mostly fixes for switching between slots in the same client window. Conquest players get them too, so it's worth updating either way.
### Fixed - Finishing your goal on one slot and then connecting to another slot in the same client window could instantly goal the new slot too, and release it if you're on auto release. Sorry about that one! - Bifrost progress made while the client was closed now only gets sent to the slot it actually belongs to. Before, connecting to a different Bifrost slot first would send it there instead, goal included. - Conquest chapters you beat while the client was disconnected now get sent when you reconnect. Before, they were lost until you restarted the client. - The "pinned save no longer found" warning shows up again after switching rooms, instead of staying quiet if you'd already seen it once.
### Changed - The client now cleans up after itself in the Bifrost folder. Bonus records for runs whose save is gone get deleted, and empty leftover folders get removed, so it stops piling up files over time. Any run you can still load keeps its records.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.11.02...2026.11.05
